executive_summary:
Recommendation: move the discourse PostgreSQL database to four purpose-built AWS services in three waves. Wave 1 moves it to Aurora PostgreSQL, the same engine family, which serves 48.2% of the queries. Wave 2 puts ElastiCache in front of 3 hot reads, 25.1% of calls. Wave 3 moves 42.0% of the queries to DynamoDB and 9.9% to DocumentDB. The target schemas for all four services are designed. The projected cost of the full modernization is $536 per month at AWS Price List on-demand prices for us-east-1, retrieved 2026-11-04. No current cost was collected for the source database, so the plan claims no saving against it. The cutover is your responsibility.

Risk: overall risk is high. The main exposure is a high-severity migration complexity risk on Aurora PostgreSQL, covering routines you migrate yourself: review it in the risk register before wave 1 starts. Before wave 3 starts, confirm the engine for the queries that routing decided by a small margin.
